minimal_central_correction: Make the B3 specificity counter-review robust to the model's single-family output shape: (a) normalize a flat single-family object ({"family":[...], representative, certainty, ...}) into the required {"families":[{...}]} partition before validation, and/or (b) tighten the specificity prompt so the model reliably emits the array shape within the 15..220-char representative_quote bound; on a failed/shape-mismatched specificity verdict, consider degrading the multi-member family to an operator-reviewable uncertain deferral (preserving B2's duplicate suppression) instead of aborting the whole batch before any write. Re-run the b3:specificity arm once under the canonical post-exit EX and adjudicate the refined families against the 16 valuable / 11 nonvaluable targets.
